items.title: Security advisory bundle AV26-966 covers SCG, ThinOS 10, Trusted Device Client, Rugged Control Center
items.summary: The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security published alert AV26-966 on Sept 28 covering four Dell security updates: DSA-2026-410 (Rugged Control Center before 5.2.206), DSA-2026-385 (Secure Connect Gateway Policy Manager before 5.36.00.16), DSA-2026-404 (ThinOS 10), and DSA-2026-408 (Trusted Device Client before 8.1.359.0). Secure Connect Gateway and ThinOS sit in a lot of installed bases.
items.why_it_matters: Cheap, credible discovery fodder: ask installed-base accounts whether they're current on Secure Connect Gateway and ThinOS patches. SCG hygiene questions open security-services conversations.

items.title: Axis cameras now manageable through Meraki Dashboard via Cisco Cloud Control
items.summary: Axis devices can now be managed in the Cisco Meraki Dashboard through Cisco Cloud Control, with an Essentials tier (device health/visibility) and an Advantage tier (video analytics, 30-day cloud storage). Physical-security cameras ride the same management and licensing model as the network.
items.why_it_matters: Cross-sell wedge: accounts with Meraki networks plus Axis cameras can consolidate physical security under one dashboard. Modest story, but it gives Meraki-heavy shops a reason to talk camera refresh.

items.title: Broadcom deauthorizes Insight Enterprises, a top-tier VMware Pinnacle partner, in North America
items.summary: Broadcom has deauthorized Insight Enterprises from reselling VMware licenses and Broadcom-funded VCF Entitlement Services in North America. Insight finishes booked work through Oct 31, 2026. Partner executives say WWT and AHEAD are positioned to absorb the share, and some warn Broadcom is punishing partners that recommend competitive alternatives. (Publication date not shown on the page; fresh in the search index, so treat as late-September.)
items.why_it_matters: Another channel-ecosystem shock from Broadcom, and it feeds the VMware-replacement narrative directly. Expect this in every VMware renewal or Nutanix displacement conversation this week.

items.title: Launches Open Agent Safety Platform with 100+ partners, including CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks
items.summary: On Sept 28 NVIDIA announced the Open Agent Safety Platform: OpenShell (open-source agent sandbox runtime) plus Sentry (out-of-band enforcement on BlueField-4 DPUs) to contain 'agent drift', with 100+ organizations including CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks collaborating.
items.why_it_matters: This is the industry's emerging trust-layer framing for agentic AI. Customers evaluating 'security for AI agents' will hear CrowdStrike's and Palo Alto's pitches against this open framework — know both positions before the customer asks.

items.title: Acquires Ryax Technologies (French AI compute orchestration)
items.summary: Nutanix acquired Ryax, whose GPU-utilization and smart-scheduling technology will be integrated into the Nutanix Kubernetes Platform and Nutanix Enterprise AI to place agentic-AI workloads on the most cost-effective hardware across private data centers, hyperscalers, and neoclouds. (Announcement appears to be ~Sept 26; article dated Sept 28.)
items.why_it_matters: Nutanix is arming its Enterprise AI story with GPU-efficiency tooling — a direct competitive datapoint against VMware's AI Factory pitch in AI-infra deals.

items.title: "Agent Resilience" extends backup/rollback to AI agent infrastructure
items.summary: Cohesity's Agent Resilience discovers, protects (immutable snapshots), and recovers AI agent memory and configuration plus the data systems agents act on. Launch support for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore/Agents; select customers now, GA targeted end of 2026. (Launched at Cohesity Catalyst ~Sept 16; fresh analyst coverage Sept 28-29.)
items.why_it_matters: Direct counterpoint to Rubrik's agentic-cyber-resilience push below — expect 'who protects our AI agents' to be a discovery question this quarter.

items.title: Adds MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for agentic cyber resilience
items.summary: Rubrik MCP exposes the Rubrik Security Cloud API schema to customer AI agents so agents can run multi-step recovery and compliance workflows, with role-based access control and OWASP MCP Top 10-aligned guardrails. Private preview now, GA targeted October 2026; Rubrik AI is already used by roughly one-third of customers. (Dateline 'September 2026'; exact announcement date not pinned down.)
items.why_it_matters: Head-to-head with Cohesity's Agent Resilience: 'agentic cyber resilience' is the competitive front in backup/security this week. Know both roadmaps.

items.title: Announces intent to acquire PEAK:AIO (next-gen metadata architecture for AI infrastructure)
items.summary: NetApp will acquire UK-based PEAK:AIO, whose next-gen metadata architecture and high-performance parallel file system disaggregate metadata from data so shared storage scales alongside GPU clusters (trillions of files, exabyte-scale). The plan is to combine it with ONTAP while preserving ONTAP's resilience, security, and operational maturity. Also: NetApp INSIGHT 2026 runs Sept 29-Oct 1 in Las Vegas — watch for product announcements today/tomorrow.
items.why_it_matters: Metadata scaling is the key technical differentiator to use in AI-infra storage conversations. And with INSIGHT starting today, brief yourself on announcements before the customer does.

prompt_of_the_day.prompt: Draft a 3-sentence customer outreach email I can send to VMware-installed accounts this week. Context: Broadcom has just deauthorized Insight Enterprises, a top-tier VMware Pinnacle partner, from reselling VMware licenses and VCF Entitlement Services in North America (Insight winds down booked work through Oct 31, 2026); partners warn Broadcom is squeezing partners that recommend alternatives. My angle: this creates continuity risk for customers whose VMware renewals or entitlement services touch Insight, and it is a natural moment to benchmark Nutanix or other alternatives before the next renewal. Keep it neutral and professional, no FUD, end with one discovery question.
